GPS_NAVFILTER.description: Navigation filter engine setting for the GPS backend.

GPS_AUTO_SWITCH.description: Controls behavior when multiple GPS receivers are present.

GPS_SBAS_MODE.description: Enables, disables or preserves SBAS configuration in the GPS.

GPS_MIN_ELEV.description: Minimum satellite elevation accepted for navigation use.

GPS_RAW_DATA.description: Controls raw GPS data logging behavior.

GPS_AUTO_CONFIG.description: Enables automatic GPS backend configuration over serial and optionally DroneCAN.

INS_GYROFFS.description: Gyro offset calibration group for the first IMU instance.

INS_ACCOFFS.description: Accelerometer offset calibration group for the first IMU instance.

INS_ENABLE_MASK.description: Mask used to enable or disable detected inertial sensor instances.

INS_GYRO_RATE.description: Fast sampling rate selection for gyro pipelines.

INS_HNTCH_ENABLE.description: Primary harmonic notch filter enable flag exposed through INS_HNTCH_ subgroup.

INS_HNTCH_FREQ.description: Center frequency for the primary harmonic notch filter subgroup.

INS4_USE.description: Per-instance enable flag for the first parameterized extended IMU slot exposed as INS4_*.

INS4_ACC_ID.description: Accelerometer device identifier for the INS4_* per-instance group.

BARO_GND_TEMP.description: User-provided ambient temperature used by barometric altitude calculations.

BARO_ALT_OFFSET.description: Altitude offset added to barometric altitude.

BARO_EXT_BUS.description: Selects which external I2C bus is probed for a barometer.

BARO_FLTR_RNG.description: Acceptance range for new barometer samples around the average.

BARO_PROBE_EXT.description: Bitmask of external barometer types to probe.

BARO_FIELD_ELV.description: User-provided field elevation used when disarmed.

BARO_ALTERR_MAX.description: Maximum acceptable disagreement between GPS altitude and pressure altitude during arming checks.

MOT_PWM_TYPE.description: Selects the motor output protocol or PWM mode.

MOT_PWM_MIN.description: Minimum PWM value used for motor outputs.

MOT_PWM_MAX.description: Maximum PWM value used for motor outputs.

MOT_THST_EXPO.description: Thrust curve exponent used by multicopter motor linearization.

MOT_SPIN_MIN.description: Normalized thrust point where motors start producing useful thrust.

MOT_SPIN_ARM.description: Normalized motor spin level used while armed before full thrust is requested.

MOT_THST_HOVER.description: Estimated normalized thrust required to hover.

MOT_HOVER_LEARN.description: Controls automatic learning and saving of hover thrust.

MOT_BAT_IDX.description: Selects which battery monitor instance feeds motor compensation.

SERVO1_MIN.description: Minimum output value for the first servo channel. Pattern repeats across channels.

SERVO1_MAX.description: Maximum output value for the first servo channel. Pattern repeats across channels.

SERVO1_TRIM.description: Trim output for the first servo channel. Pattern repeats across channels.

SERVO1_REVERSED.description: Reversal flag for the first servo channel. Pattern repeats across channels.

SERVO1_FUNCTION.description: Assigned function for the first servo channel. Pattern repeats across channels.

SERVO_DSHOT_RATE.description: Global DShot update rate setting for servo outputs.

EK2_GPS_TYPE.description: Controls how GPS measurements are fused by EKF2.

EK2_ALT_SOURCE.description: Selects the primary altitude source for EKF2.

EK2_MAG_CAL.description: Determines the default magnetometer fusion strategy.

EK2_IMU_MASK.description: Selects which IMU lanes can be used by EKF2 cores.

EK2_GPS_CHECK.description: Bitmask of GPS quality checks applied by EKF2.

EK2_RNG_USE_HGT.description: Controls switching to rangefinder as a height source near ground.

EK2_FLOW_USE.description: Selects when optical flow is used by EKF2.

EK2_GSF_RUN_MASK.description: Selects which lanes run the GSF yaw estimator.

EK2_GSF_USE_MASK.description: Selects which lanes may use the GSF yaw estimator result.

EK3_VELNE_M_NSE.description: GPS horizontal velocity measurement noise lower bound used by EKF3.

EK3_ALT_M_NSE.description: Altitude measurement noise used by EKF3 for height fusion.

EK3_MAG_CAL.description: Default magnetometer fusion mode for EKF3.

EK3_IMU_MASK.description: Selects which IMU lanes EKF3 may use.

EK3_GPS_CHECK.description: Bitmask of GPS quality checks applied by EKF3.

EK3_FLOW_USE.description: Controls when optical flow is used by EKF3.

EK3_GSF_RUN_MASK.description: Selects which EKF3 lanes run the GSF yaw estimator.

EK3_GSF_USE_MASK.description: Selects which EKF3 lanes may use the GSF yaw estimator result.

EK3_ERR_THRESH.description: Error threshold parameter used by EKF3 lane management.

EK3_AFFINITY.description: Lane affinity configuration parameter for EKF3.

EK3_SRC1_POSXY.description: Source selector for horizontal position in EKF3 source set 1.

EK3_SRC1_VELXY.description: Source selector for horizontal velocity in EKF3 source set 1.

EK3_SRC1_POSZ.description: Source selector for vertical position in EKF3 source set 1.

EK3_SRC1_YAW.description: Source selector for yaw in EKF3 source set 1.

ATC_RATE_FF_ENAB.description: Enables or disables body-frame rate feedforward.

ATC_ANGLE_BOOST.description: Adds throttle boost as lean angle increases.

ATC_INPUT_TC.description: Input time constant used for attitude target shaping.

ATC_ANGLE_MAX.description: Maximum lean angle used across flight modes.

ATC_RATE_WPY_MAX.description: Maximum yaw target slew rate for autonomous modes.

AHRS_EKF_TYPE.description: Vehicle-level selector that decides which EKF backend is used for flight control.

BATT_MONITOR.description: Selects the battery monitor backend type for the primary battery instance.

BATT_CAPACITY.description: Configured full battery capacity in mAh for the primary battery instance.

BATT_SERIAL_NUM.description: Battery serial number or DroneCAN battery_id for the primary battery instance.

BATT_LOW_TIMER.description: Timeout before low-voltage failsafe is triggered.

BATT_FS_VOLTSRC.description: Chooses raw or sag-compensated voltage for battery failsafe checks.

BATT_LOW_VOLT.description: Low battery voltage threshold for the primary battery instance.

BATT_LOW_MAH.description: Low remaining capacity threshold for the primary battery instance.

BATT_CRT_VOLT.description: Critical battery voltage threshold for the primary battery instance.

BATT_CRT_MAH.description: Critical remaining capacity threshold for the primary battery instance.

BATT_FS_LOW_ACT.description: Vehicle action to perform on low battery failsafe.

BATT_FS_CRT_ACT.description: Vehicle action to perform on critical battery failsafe.

BATT_ARM_MAH.description: Minimum remaining capacity required for arming.

BATT_ESC_INDEX.description: ESC telemetry index used for outbound battery data mirroring.

BATT_VOLT_PIN.description: Analog pin used to read battery voltage on the primary battery instance.

BATT_CURR_PIN.description: Analog pin used to read battery current on the primary battery instance.

BATT_VOLT_MULT.description: Voltage multiplier used by the analog battery backend.

BATT_AMP_PERVLT.description: Current-per-volt scaling used by the analog battery backend.

BATT_AMP_OFFSET.description: Current offset used by the analog battery backend.

BATT_SUM_MASK.description: Monitor selection mask for sum battery monitors.

BATT_ESC_MASK.description: ESC selection mask used by the ESC battery backend.

SERIAL0_BAUD.description: Baud rate for serial port 0 exposed at vehicle parameter level.

SERIAL1_BAUD.description: Baud rate for serial port 1 exposed at vehicle parameter level.

SERIAL2_BAUD.description: Baud rate for serial port 2 exposed at vehicle parameter level.

BATT2_MONITOR.description: Selects the battery monitor backend type for the second battery instance.
